title: Better Call Saul — Slippin' Jimmy

hook.context: Jimmy mijozlarni tinchlantirish uchun doim shunday deydi. "S'all" = "It's all" ning tez aytilishi. Keyinchalik u o'z yangi ismini ham shu iboradan oladi: Saul Goodman → "S'all good, man".

reading: Jimmy McGill is a small-time lawyer who works from a tiny office in the back of a nail salon. He has a lot of energy and charm, but very few clients.
Years ago, Jimmy was a con man called Slippin' Jimmy. He must have tricked hundreds of people before his older brother Chuck helped him start a new life.
Chuck is a respected lawyer at a big firm. He seems to support Jimmy, but secretly he believes that Jimmy can't have changed. "A leopard can't change its spots," he thinks.
Jimmy works hard and studies law by post. Whenever he fails, people say, "He might have cheated again," and sometimes they are right.
Kim Wexler, a smart lawyer and Jimmy's closest friend, sees the good side of him. She knows he could be a great lawyer if he followed the rules.
But step by step, Jimmy chooses the easy, dishonest way. He becomes Saul Goodman, a colourful lawyer who helps criminals.
Watching the show, you keep thinking: he must have known where this road would take him. Or maybe he couldn't have stopped even if he had wanted to.

grammar.title: Taxmin modallari: must / might / can't (have done)
explain: Hozirgi taxmin: **must** — deyarli aniq (90%): He's smiling, he **must** be happy. **might / may / could** — ehtimol (50%). **can't** — imkonsiz deb o'ylaymiz: He **can't** be a lawyer, he's too young.
O'tmish haqida taxmin: **modal + have + V3**. He **must have tricked** hundreds of people (ishonchim komil). He **might have cheated** (ehtimol). He **can't have changed** (bo'lishi mumkin emas).
Diqqat: taxminda **mustn't** ishlatilmaydi! Inkor ishonch uchun **can't**: "He mustn't be at home" emas → He **can't** be at home.
**couldn't have** — o'tmishda imkonsiz bo'lgan: He **couldn't have stopped** even if he had wanted to.

exercises.q: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
He has three cars. He ___ be rich.
Jimmy ___ tricked hundreds of people. Everyone knows his past.
exercises.why: O'tmish taxmini, ishonch: must have + V3.

exercises.q: I'm not sure where Kim is. She ___ have gone to court.
You ___ have seen him yesterday. He was in another city.
The floor is wet. It ___ have rained.
She ___ forgotten our meeting — she's never late. Maybe she's ill.
exercises.why: Bu unga xos emas → can't have forgotten.
